audience: marketers and growth teams who message customers with Customer.io

useCases.title: Check how a campaign performed
useCases.text: The AI reads a campaign and its delivery and engagement metrics over time. It sums up how the campaign did.

useCases.title: See what a person received
useCases.text: The AI finds a person with an attribute filter, then lists their attributes, the segments they belong to and the messages sent to them. You see what this customer got.

useCases.title: List the people in a segment
useCases.text: The AI lists all segments and then searches people with a segment or attribute filter. You get the people who match.

useCases.title: Review recent deliveries across the workspace
useCases.text: The AI lists sent messages filtered by type, campaign or newsletter. You can check what went out and compare campaigns.

useCases.title: Send a transactional email or trigger a broadcast
useCases.text: The AI sends one transactional email from a template to a recipient, or triggers an API-triggered broadcast. This sends real messages.
